_curation_note: PQSigner #498 semantic curation: feeApproval is admitted only for the fixed Ethereum mainnet StakedLBTC proxy below. The signed fee is the maximum LBTC fee ceiling accepted by AssetRouter; the router may charge less through its independently configured maximum-mint-commission cap. The production off-chain typed-data path carries no authenticated ERC-20 metadata, so the fee display identifies a maximum LBTC fee and labels the exact 256-bit raw base-unit word as hexadecimal; it never scales or rounds it. Fixed-block metadata establishes the denomination for semantic evidence but does not grant runtime display-metadata authority. Evidence pins the proxy/implementation runtimes, official source/compiler closure, EIP-712 domain name/version/deployment, canonical typehash, and maximum-fee consumer semantics. It is historical fixed-block authority, not live commission configuration, signature validity, execution success, future proxy upgrades, fallback, blind signing, hardware, production, or shipment authority.
